title: The Bodyguard
tagline: Never let her out of your sight.
about: A former Secret Service agent is hired to protect a singer and actress from a stalker, and breaks his own rule by falling for her.
cue: Serve the fondant when Frank leaps in front of Rachel at the Academy Awards.
faces: One night only. Bags checked at the door.

Smoked brisket, pickles and hot mustard on milk buns.How to make it500g smoked beef brisket, thinly sliced8 soft milk buns125ml beef stock3 tbsp smoky barbecue sauce2 tbsp hot English mustard3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise16 dill pickle slicesWarm the stock and barbecue sauce in a wide pan, add the brisket and heat through gently.Split and toast the buns.Mix the mustard and mayonnaise and spread it on the bases.Pile on the brisket and pickles, put the lids on and serve hot.Katana-cut seared tuna with ponzuFrank's sword slices Rachel's scarf in two. Seared tuna, ponzu, sesame and spring onion.How to make it400g sashimi-grade tuna loin2 tbsp sesame seeds1 tbsp neutral oil4 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp lemon juice1 tbsp rice vinegar1 tsp caster sugar2 spring onions, finely sliced1 Lebanese cucumber, cut in thin ribbonsStir the soy, lemon juice, rice vinegar and sugar together for the ponzu.Roll the tuna in the sesame seeds.Sear in the hot oil for 30 seconds a side so the middle stays raw, then rest a minute.Slice thinly with your sharpest knife and lay over the cucumber ribbons.Spoon over the ponzu and scatter with spring onion.SupperMiami benefit snapper with mango salsaRachel meets Portman at the Miami party. Crisp-skin snapper, mango salsa and coconut rice.How to make it4 snapper fillets, skin on300g jasmine rice400ml coconut milk1 ripe mango, diced1 small red onion, finely diced1 long red chilli, finely chopped1 lime, juiced1 cup coriander leaves2 tbsp olive oilRinse the rice and simmer it with the coconut milk, 200ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, until tender.Mix the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice and coriander for the salsa.Score the fish skin, season and fry skin-side down in the hot oil until crisp, then flip for a minute.Serve the snapper on the rice with the salsa on top.Herb Farmer's lake cabin beef pot pieHiding out at Herb's cabin on the lake. Slow beef, mushrooms and thyme under flaky pastry.How to make it1kg beef chuck, cut in chunks2 tbsp plain flour2 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion, diced2 carrots, diced250g button mushrooms, halved2 tbsp tomato paste500ml beef stock4 thyme sprigs2 sheets of frozen puff pastry1 egg, beatenToss the beef in seasoned flour and brown it in batches in the oil.Soften the onion and carrots, stir in the tomato paste, then return the beef with the stock and thyme.Cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart, adding the mushrooms for the last 30 minutes.Spoon into a pie dish, lay the pastry over, brush with egg and bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.After the ShowBest Actress gold chocolate fondantAnd the Best Actress is Rachel Marron. Molten dark chocolate, gold dust and cream.How to make it150g dark chocolate, chopped150g butter, plus extra for the moulds3 eggs3 egg yolks75g caster sugar2 tbsp plain flour1 tbsp cocoa powder1 tsp edible gold dust200ml thickened cream, softly whippedButter 4 moulds and dust them with cocoa.Melt the chocolate and butter together gently.Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the chocolate and flour.Fill the moulds and bake at 200°C until set on top but still soft in the middle.Turn out, dust with gold and serve with the cream.From the BarThe bodyguard's orange juice, straight or notFrank asks for orange juice on the job. Blood orange, vodka and soda over ice.How to make it6 blood oranges, juiced180ml vodka300ml soda water, chilled4 orange slices2 cups iceFill 4 tall glasses with ice.Pour in the vodka and blood orange juice.Top with soda, stir once and add an orange slice.Champagne on ice for the Oscar partyOpened only if she wins.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
